title: london stocks edge lower elevated oil prices stoke inflation concerns 2026 09 10
text:
Sept 10 (Reuters) - London shares hovered around one-month ​lows on Thursday as oil prices continued to fuel inflation worries ‌in a week packed with economic data, while energy stocks helped keep a lid on losses.
The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE)
, opens new tab
 fell 0.4% to 10,627.80 points by 0946 GMT, while the ​midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC)
, opens new tab
 slipped 0.38%.
